critical_code_review_comments: google_session stores emergent session_token verbatim — fine but fixed 7d expiry ignores whatever Emergent returns.
JobCreate spread into mongo doc: if frontend passes extra fields they'd be stored (minor).
/api/applications/{application_id} has no auth — any caller can read application questions by id (low risk since ids are random, but recommend auth).
get_object/put_object use blocking requests inside async endpoints — will block event loop on large uploads.
